data.name: Title
data.value: Wrap switch section bodies in braces

data.name: Message
data.value: Wrap all statements in this switch section in a block

data.name: Description
data.value: Every nonempty switch section must contain a single block statement.

data.name: MemberOrderingMessage
data.value: Order type members by category, staticness, accessibility, and name using ordinal comparison

data.name: MemberOrderingDescription
data.value: Order constants, fields, constructors, finalizers, properties, indexers, conversion operators, operators, and methods, sorting static before instance, public before internal, protected, and private members, and names using ordinal comparison.

data.name: StatementSpacingMessage
data.value: This item has incorrect blank-line spacing

data.name: StatementSpacingDescription
data.value: Do not leave a blank line after a type declaration's opening brace. Require blank lines between brace-terminated sibling statements or type members, between switch sections, and before compound control-flow statements.

data.name: SingleTopLevelTypePerFileTitle
data.value: Keep one top-level type per file

data.name: SingleTopLevelTypePerFileMessage
data.value: Each C# source file must contain exactly one top-level type declaration

data.name: SingleTopLevelTypePerFileDescription
data.value: Each C# source file must contain exactly one top-level class, struct, interface, record, enum, or delegate declaration. Nested types do not count separately.

data.name: AutoImplementedPropertyLineTitle
data.value: Keep auto-implemented properties on one line

data.name: AutoImplementedPropertyLineMessage
data.value: This auto-implemented property must fit on one line

data.name: AutoImplementedPropertyLineDescription
data.value: Auto-implemented property declarations, including their accessors, must be written on one line. Expression-bodied and custom-accessor properties are not affected.

data.name: DocumentationCommentLayoutMessage
data.value: This XML documentation comment has inconsistent line layout

data.name: DocumentationCommentLayoutDescription
data.value: Single-paragraph XML documentation elements should fit on one line. Elements containing block markup or paragraph breaks may remain multiline, and all continuation comment markers must align with the first marker.
